about: South of the South-east Varrock mine's star site with 99 Mining and a rune pickaxe, for shooting stars.
notes: ::star land varrock_south_east_mine 9 lands a size-9 star on the site just north (3290, 3353); ::star lists the star and the next landing, ::star sites the others, ::star layer ends a layer. A charged amulet of glory is worn (the gem table's extra roll); take it off to compare. The loadout is ours.
